principle: Translate operator intent, object, context and state; never invert screen coordinates directly.

mission_engine.input_rule: source_gesture -> mission -> target_gesture_sequence; never source_coordinate -> target_coordinate_without_mission

route_priority.titan: Titan Web API HTTP/JSON where the required provider/script is exposed
route_priority.grandma3: Command Line, OSC and Lua plugin/object API where enabled

route_priority.titan: Titan Remote/TitanNet or documented remote path
route_priority.grandma3: Web Remote, MIDI/DMX/OSC remote inputs and Sessions

route_priority.titan: Only after inspection of the concrete Windows surface
route_priority.grandma3: Only after inspection of the concrete Windows surface

capability_gate.principle: A visible software control is not proof that the concrete installation can safely edit or emit output.
capability_gate.promotion_rule: Learning may remain valid at semantic_editing while dmx_output is closed; live execution requires the target gate to be observed open in an isolated reversible show.

show_schema.principle: Project/show data is not a generic folder and cannot be assumed symmetric across hosts.
show_schema.provenance_rule: Keep host version, show version and extraction route in every learned observation.

surface_input_policy.prohibition: A visual overlay alone does not move the host click and blind coordinates are not an equivalence proof.

runtime_observation.interpretation: No runtime probe has been performed; start nothing automatically.

titan_route.surface: Read-only D4Z copy, Show.xml index, Titan Web API or Capture-linked state

grandma3_route.surface: Show Creator Export, command line, Lua object API, PSR/MVR/GDTF on an isolated copy

operations.loss_or_risk: Titan exposes a readable container structure, while grandMA3 export is object- and dependency-scoped; PSR/import can clear Programmer or merge data and must not be treated as passive reading.
operations.visual_rule: Show extraction route, show version, object type, dependencies and side effects in peek.
operations.input_rule: Read-only indexing first; export before import; never parse or rewrite proprietary show binaries by assumption.

titan_route.surface: Fixture/Group windows, keypad or executor/macro control

grandma3_route.surface: Fixture Sheet, Group Pool, command line or Preset Pool

native_route.titan: Titan Web API Programmer.OnOff.Selection.SetNewHandleSelection using user-number or handle-list identifiers.
native_route.grandma3: Official OSC command route: send /cmd with OSC type s and command-line text Fixture <id> + Fixture <id>; Receive Command must be enabled on the target.

operations.loss_or_risk: A Titan group click cannot be assumed to select the same granularity as a grandMA3 parent fixture or subfixture.
operations.visual_rule: Show the familiar source position, but outline the actual target object and hierarchy level.
operations.input_rule: Route only after the target object and hierarchy level are known; do not send a blind coordinate click.

titan_route.surface: IPCGBESFX bank and wheels or Attribute Editor

grandma3_route.surface: Encoder Bar, context-sensitive encoder toolbar or Fixture Sheet

native_route.titan: Titan Web API includes Programmer.Editor.Fixtures.SetControlValueByName for currently selected fixtures; it can place the value in the Programmer.
native_route.grandma3: Official OSC command route: send /cmd with OSC type s and command-line text Attribute "<attribute>" At <value>; Receive Command must be enabled on the target.

operations.loss_or_risk: The same apparent position can address pan, color, beam or a timing control depending on bank/page/layer context.
operations.visual_rule: Use the source visual grammar and a colored outline for the destination encoder context; show the active bank/page in peek.
operations.input_rule: Set or verify context before the value gesture. Mouse remapping alone is insufficient.

titan_route.surface: Colours, Gobos, Positions windows or macro/executor

native_route.titan: Titan Web API Palette.ApplyPalette with handle_userNumber or handle_titanId and usePaletteTimes; palette handle identity must be resolved first.
native_route.grandma3: Official command-line route: select fixtures, then send /cmd with OSC type s and command-line text At Preset <feature_group>.<preset>; preset mode and fixture compatibility must be verified.

operations.loss_or_risk: A Titan palette maps conceptually to a preset, but Selective/Global/Universal modes and recipes may not have a one-click Titan equivalent.
operations.visual_rule: Mark whether the destination is a direct preset value, a recipe, or a lossy approximation.
operations.input_rule: Require a confirmation/peek when conversion changes scope or source priority.

titan_route.surface: Cue List window and connected playback

native_route.grandma3: Official command-line route: send /cmd with OSC type s and Store Sequence <sequence> Cue <cue> [/Overwrite]; cue parts, recipes and timing require explicit arguments.

operations.loss_or_risk: A Titan cue list and a grandMA3 sequence may look like a stack, but grandMA3 exposes cue parts, layers and recipes as additional structure.
operations.visual_rule: Use a graph/stack representation that reveals hidden cue parts instead of pretending one row equals one row.
operations.input_rule: Do not translate a click until the selected sequence/cue/part is identified.

titan_route.surface: Playback window, fader, virtual fader or executor/macro button

grandma3_route.surface: Executor/Playback Window or onPC executor controls

native_route.titan: Titan Web API exposes playback fire/level/kill scripts; exact endpoint must be probed read-only first.
native_route.grandma3: OSC can address command-line playback commands; plugins can expose object-aware actions.

operations.loss_or_risk: Titan presents the stored cue list through a playback; grandMA3 Executor is a handle that sends control commands to a sequence in the pool. The visible control does not own the same data.
operations.visual_rule: Show both the familiar control and the real sequence/executor ownership in peek.
operations.input_rule: Resolve executor function and controlled sequence before Go, fader or flash input.

titan_route.surface: Fan or Align functions with attribute wheels

grandma3_route.surface: MAtricks window, Selection Grid, Align Bar or Encoder Bar

operations.loss_or_risk: A Titan Fan can look like a simple MAtricks result, but grandMA3 can retain grid, wings, layers, shuffle and transform state that Titan does not expose in the same object.
operations.visual_rule: Outline the selection transform context, not just the wheel or button; show grid/order and active attribute mask in peek.
operations.input_rule: Resolve selection model and environment before applying a transform. Never map Fan to a generic encoder click.

titan_route.surface: Blind mode, Programmer, cue list and Visualiser

grandma3_route.surface: Preview environment, Sequence Sheet, Track Sheet, Content Sheet and Output/DMX views

operations.loss_or_risk: Preview/Blind state can protect output, but storing or updating can still affect live data depending on the host and operation.
operations.visual_rule: Use a distinct environment indicator; peek must not be confused with Blind or Preview.
operations.input_rule: Require an explicit environment state before store/update/record actions; default to read-only.

titan_route.surface: Patch, Capture Visualiser and linked Capture show

grandma3_route.surface: Patch menu, Clone, Layout, MVR and 3D/fixture hierarchy

operations.loss_or_risk: A visual replacement can propagate through many show objects; blindly translating it could rewrite the project rather than operate it.
operations.visual_rule: Mark propagation scope and dependencies; keep this class read-only during learning.
operations.input_rule: No live write route until a user-approved, reversible clone/patch test exists.

titan_route.surface: Playback controls, Release menu and Playback Groups

grandma3_route.surface: Running Playbacks window or Off Menu

native_route.titan: Titan Web API exposes KillPlayback and KillAllPlaybacks; release-mask semantics still require host-state verification.
native_route.grandma3: Running Playbacks/Off Menu are documented UI routes; OSC/command-line can address object playback controls.

operations.loss_or_risk: Kill, Off, Release and Fade-to-zero can produce different residual output and future playback behavior.
operations.visual_rule: Use different colors and labels for kill, off, release and fade; show the affected object and source.
operations.input_rule: Require confirmation for release-all/everything-off and keep an immediate rollback/peek path.

titan_route.surface: Synergy Fixtures, Media Browser, Attribute Editor or linked media server

grandma3_route.surface: Media Pools, Bitmap, Appearance, Sound, Video and Data Pool windows

operations.loss_or_risk: A media surface or bitmap can look like a lighting fixture but has different ownership, timing, network and master behavior.
operations.visual_rule: Use a distinct media color family and show server/pool/layer identity in peek.
operations.input_rule: Resolve subsystem and data pool before operating; do not send a lighting fixture command to a media object.

titan_route.surface: Titan Web API, Titan Remote, TitanNet, DMX Settings, MIDI/SMPTE and network interfaces

grandma3_route.surface: Command Line, OSC, Web Remote, In & Out, DMX Protocols and Session controls

operations.loss_or_risk: The same transport event can trigger a command without owning output priority; network inputs and remote routes can affect live state unexpectedly.
operations.visual_rule: Show the familiar source control while revealing the actual transport, host, interface and semantic target in peek.
operations.input_rule: Prefer object-aware native routes; require an armed, reversible probe before sending writes through any transport.

current_blocker: No live semantic calibration has been performed on the actual Titan and grandMA3 windows; the local 083 contract is not that evidence.
